brief: A three-storey cabinet with at least three drawers.

requirements.evidence: Stack at 0,0: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:0,0,1;full, piece:0,0,2;full plus adjacent half-w pieces at same levels give a 3-level high cabinet (levels 0-2).
Three notch drawer frames: notch:0#0,1#notch1 (level 0), notch:1#0,1#notch1 (level 1), notch:2#0,1#notch1 (level 2) all hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm - one per storey.

finish.summary: Built a 3-high stack (full+half-w at each level) forming a cabinet, with a drawer frame fitted in the notch between the columns at each of the three storeys. Mesh clash clear, only open cap faces as info.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
